correctness.rationale: Direct cellular Lefschetz reconstruction: each invariant cubical cell is constant on each resource-cycle; the alternating trace orientation simplifies to (-1) per edge-assigned cycle, giving the finite surjection sum. Inclusion-exclusion yields \(1+(-1)^{c+m}F_m(c)\), and the nonequivariant Kozlov sphere-wedge theorem concentrates reduced homology in dimension \(n-m\). The sign of a resource permutation is \((-1)^{n-c}\), establishing the claimed character in all boundary cases. Average over S_n vanishes through the falling factorial zero for \(a<n\), and rational quotient transfer applies after equivariant subdivision. Exact cell-level checker exhaustively passed for eight parameter pairs.

value.rationale: A naturally defined label-permutation symmetry of resource-reconfiguration spaces is resolved on the entire nonzero rational homology, for all finite trees and all resource counts. It refines known homology ranks to an exact conjugacy-class character, proves shape independence at representation level, and establishes rational acyclicity of the unlabeled quotient despite often large original Betti numbers. These consequences capture topologically meaningful indistinguishable-resource information, not a parameter-renaming or isolated exercise.
